name: Crunchy persimmon
summary: Crunchy persimmon from the orchards, sweet and aromatic. Freshly picked fruit is also called sweet, soft, and juicy.
origin: Visitors buy hồng giòn as a gift because the fruit is sweet and aromatic.
taste: The gift fruit is sweet and aromatic.
Freshly picked fruit is also called sweet, soft, and juicy.
howToEat: Eat it fresh, or carry it home.
One season line is late October and November. Another puts the crunchy season from September through December.
where: Orchards at the end of Mimosa Pass, and roads around the Cau Dat tea hills.
